sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS parentProductSku, p.ProductName AS name FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND EXISTS (SELECT e.ZnodeProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity e INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity w ON w.VersionId = e.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog k ON k.PublishCatalogId = e.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE e.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND k.PortalId = po.PortalId AND w.RevisionType = @publishState AND w.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND e.IsActive = @isActive AND e.IsObsolete = @false AND e.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = p.SKU AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId), @zero) >= @minStock AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY p.SKU
